properties.name: Authority-space closure
properties.definition: No modeled or projected authorization path grants authority outside the approved Permitted Action Set.
properties.key_assumptions: Approved A_P is complete for the declared scope.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: bounded/exhaustive authority analysis or formal proof plus projection conformance

properties.name: Region coverage
properties.definition: Every action/context in the declared covered domain resolves to governance treatment or an explicit unknown/indeterminate/refusal disposition.
properties.key_assumptions: The covered action/context domain is finitely or otherwise precisely characterized.

properties.name: Region-to-contract mapping completeness
properties.definition: Every applicable region requiring transition governance resolves to defined transition contract semantics.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: exhaustive mapping analysis within profile scope

properties.name: CTC well-formedness
properties.definition: Each required CTC contains the six core semantic components and resolvable mandatory references.
properties.key_assumptions: The profile identifies required fields and reference domains.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: schema/type validation plus semantic reference checks

properties.name: CTC satisfiability
properties.definition: Relevant CTC predicates admit at least one valuation under declared assumptions where the contract is intended to be usable.
properties.key_assumptions: Predicate semantics and assumptions are explicit.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: SAT/SMT/exhaustive finite analysis or justified alternative

properties.name: No silent weakening
properties.definition: Composition does not silently discard mandatory obligations absent an explicit applicable authorized non-monotonic rule.
properties.key_assumptions: Composition operators and override semantics are declared.
properties.v0_1_status: proof obligation; restricted monotone argument; finite defect fixture
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: proof or exhaustive bounded analysis for all permitted composition operators/override rules

properties.name: Invariant preservation
properties.definition: Authorized governed transitions preserve applicable constitutional and system invariants.
properties.key_assumptions: Invariant predicates and transition semantics are defined.

properties.name: Authorization satisfiability
properties.definition: Intended authorization classes contain admissible witnesses rather than being unintentionally impossible.
properties.key_assumptions: Authority/evidence predicates and assumptions are explicit.

properties.name: Target-state reachability
properties.definition: A legitimate governed transition can reach an acceptable target state where the profile intends success to be possible.

properties.name: Evidence-source capability
properties.definition: Required evidence types can be produced by declared admissible evidence sources under profile assumptions.
properties.key_assumptions: Evidence source interfaces and availability assumptions are declared.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: source qualification, interface tests, operational availability evidence

properties.name: Successful closure reachability
properties.definition: Legitimate executions can reach successful evidentiary closure when the profile makes a meaningful success claim.
properties.key_assumptions: Target-state and closure semantics are defined.

properties.name: No unauthorized closure
properties.definition: Successful closure cannot occur unless required authorization and closure conditions hold.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: formal safety analysis plus implementation conformance testing

properties.name: Nonvacuity
properties.definition: A safety result is not accepted merely because legitimate success states are unreachable.
properties.key_assumptions: The profile intends at least one legitimate successful behavior.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: positive witness paired with safety result

properties.name: Projection soundness
properties.definition: Target artifacts do not grant authority beyond or weaken mandatory semantics of the canonical approved model.
properties.key_assumptions: Source and target semantics and mapping are defined.
properties.v0_1_status: semantic-preservation proof obligation; finite projection defect fixture
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: compiler/refinement proof, differential analysis, target conformance tests

properties.name: Closure-projection soundness
properties.definition: A target representation cannot claim successful closure under conditions weaker than the canonical model.
properties.key_assumptions: Canonical and target closure semantics are comparable.
properties.v0_1_status: semantic-preservation proof obligation; finite defect fixture
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: projection/refinement analysis plus downstream conformance evidence

properties.name: Commit freshness
properties.definition: A stale proposal-time authorization cannot commit after a material authority/evidence/state/governance change when the profile requires current eligibility.
properties.key_assumptions: The profile defines freshness-sensitive conditions and commit semantics.
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: atomic/fencing/revalidation proof and adversarial runtime testing

properties.name: Deployment non-bypassability
properties.definition: Within the declared deployment boundary, every consequence-producing route for a governed effect is mediated by the required enforcement path or otherwise structurally unable to produce the effect.
properties.key_assumptions: Boundary/routes/identities/privileged paths are enumerated sufficiently for the claim.
properties.v0_1_status: deployment claim; not established by package semantics
properties.concrete_profile_evidence: route coverage analysis, configuration/identity evidence, negative/adversarial testing, target-side observation
